description: Policy-as-Code taxonomy for governed cloud-native data pipeline CI/CD.

categories.description: Governance metadata required to evaluate and trace a release.
Governed dataset schemas, contracts, compatibility, and public-output privacy.
Governed transformation definitions and approved transformation scope.
Rules controlling whether an evaluated change may be promoted.
Policies derived from runtime quality, freshness, integrity, and execution outcomes.

policies.title: Required governance metadata
policies.description: Require the normalized governance metadata needed to make a reproducible policy decision.

policies.title: Governed Gold schema compatibility
policies.description: Deny removal, incompatible change, or violation of a required governed Gold contract.

policies.title: Public Gold privacy boundary
policies.description: Deny governed sensitive fields from public Gold outputs.

policies.title: Governed transformation definition
policies.description: Deny unapproved or out-of-scope governed transformation definitions.

policies.title: Release promotion decision
policies.description: Deny promotion when any blocking policy violation remains unresolved.

policies.title: Critical data-quality outcome
policies.description: Deny promotion when a governed critical data-quality validation fails.

policies.title: Freshness threshold
policies.description: Deny promotion when governed source or output freshness exceeds its configured threshold.

policies.title: Runtime execution integrity
policies.description: Deny promotion when pipeline execution, isolated output validation, canonical protection, or Athena execution integrity fails.
